name: QuantiPhy — Overall MRA
protocol: QuantiPhy v1 full 3,355-question video-plus-one-prior setting, overall MRA; prior-only, counterfactual and CoT ablations excluded.

explanation.en: MRA averages ten relative-error tolerances over valid parsed answers, then macro-averages four kinematic categories; parse failures are reported separately.
explanation.zh: MRA 只在可解析的有效数值答案上按十个相对误差阈值汇总，再对四类运动学任务等权平均；解析失败率另行报告。

summary.en: QuantiPhy evaluates quantitative physical estimation from valid parsed answers to real-world video.
summary.zh: QuantiPhy 评估模型从真实视频中估算物理量的能力。

task_format.en: Given a video and one physical prior, estimate object size, velocity, or acceleration with units.
task_format.zh: 给定视频和一个已知物理量，估算物体尺寸、速度或加速度并附单位。
